headline: The Elementary School Building Committee narrowed Neary renovation designs, while the Planning Board reviewed proposed two-family zoning amendments and utility tree trimming.
synopsis: The Elementary School Building Committee directed architects to remove central administration offices from future Neary Elementary School design plans and rejected a 10-year phased maintenance approach to avoid student disruption. Meanwhile, the Planning Board reviewed draft zoning amendments that would remove the two-year waiting period to convert single-family homes into two-family dwellings. The Planning Board also approved National Grid's annual utility pruning plan and recommended a conditional 90-day temporary occupancy permit for Fay School.

highlights.title: Central administration offices removed from Neary School designs
highlights.why: The committee instructed architects to drop central school district offices from future design iterations to preserve space exclusively for fourth and fifth grade educational needs.

highlights.title: Ten-year phased repair plan rejected for Neary
highlights.why: Committee members dismissed a decade-long capital repair schedule, concluding that continuous construction would severely disrupt students without delivering modern learning spaces.

highlights.title: Zoning amendments drafted for two-family home conversions
highlights.why: The board reviewed proposed warrant language to eliminate the mandatory two-year waiting period for two-family conversions ahead of a scheduled September public hearing.

highlights.title: National Grid power line pruning plan approved
highlights.why: The board and the town tree warden approved tree pruning along four town streets to maintain required clearances around electrical distribution lines.

highlights.title: Fay School addition recommended for temporary occupancy
highlights.why: The board voted 3-0 to recommend a 90-day temporary occupancy permit on the condition that the school submit a mitigation plan for removed trees and landscape discrepancies.
